emotions.label: Joy
emotions.description: Expressed happiness, delight, smiling facial action units (AU6, AU12) or positive prosody.

emotions.label: Surprise
emotions.description: Eyebrow raise, eye widening (AU1, AU2, AU5), sudden pitch shift.

emotions.label: Neutral
emotions.description: Baseline facial expression and conversational prosody without strong affective inflection.

emotions.label: Fear
emotions.description: Raised and pulled together brows (AU1, AU4), tense mouth, speech hesitation.

emotions.label: Sadness
emotions.description: Inner corners of eyebrows raised (AU1), downturned lip corners (AU15), lowered pitch tone.

emotions.label: Anger
emotions.description: Lowered and drawn together brows (AU4), tight lips, increased vocal intensity.

sentiments.label: Positive
sentiments.description: Affirmative, cooperative, or constructive multimodal cues.

sentiments.label: Negative
sentiments.description: Critical, adversarial, or distressing multimodal cues.
